sections.t: Upper A and the 3 km easy run were planned, but only a 2.5 km walk was logged. That makes one lifting session done this week so far.
Rest day, no run. A relaxed walk is fine, and set out your gym gear tonight for tomorrow's Lower B.
Rest days still need the full 130 g protein within about 1,750 kcal, so spread it over three or four meals. Start with a Skyr berry bowl and finish with Hake with lentils.

Yesterday's Upper A and easy run were missed, and so was last Sunday's long run. If you feel fresh, Upper A fits today since it does not clash with tomorrow's legs, and keep Sunday's long run at about 3.3 km because your longest run in the past 30 days is 3.0 km.
